paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: This line plot compares the BLEU scores of two models, Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi, under a prefix-constrained decoding setting for simultaneous machine translation, with varying lengths of gold prefixes. The x-axis represents the length of the gold prefix, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 2, with no units specified. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, with a linear scale ranging from 23 to 29. The Consistency-CE model is represented by a blue line with circle markers and a dashed line style, starting at approximately 24.2 and ending at 28.2, showing an increasing trend. The Consistency-Bi model is represented by an orange line with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 28 and ending at 24.4, showing a declining trend.
